description: This file defines an internal class 'TicTacToeState' that manages the game state and logic for a Tic Tac Toe game within an Android application. It handles game states, move application, state persistence, and providing status updates to the UI.

classes.name: TicTacToeState
classes.description: Manages the internal state of a Tic Tac Toe game, including the game board, current turn, game status, and methods for updating, resetting, and restoring game state.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Applies a move to the game state at the specified index if valid; updates game status; returns a MoveResult indicating the outcome.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game to its initial state with an empty board and starting with player X.

methods.name: statusText
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly string indicating the current game status or outcome.

methods.name: saveToBundle
methods.description: Saves the current game state into an Android Bundle for persistence across configuration changes or process death.

methods.name: restoreFromBundle
methods.description: Restores the game state from an Android Bundle, reconstructing the game board, turn, status, and win line.
